answer: A registry can run a quadratic bond curve: the first identity from one funding source locks 50 POA for 30 days, and the n-th locks 50*n^2, so the tenth fake costs 5,000 POA. Each epoch a random panel of 9 auditors draws a challenge, and an operator who tries to wander between accounts leaves an echo in shared timing and funding traces. Anyone can replay those signed traces from the ledger, and a confirmed cluster loses 40% of every bond, while a clean opal-grade history unlocks a lower curve.
